plaatsen.tekst: [[To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of David.]] Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer
Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.
Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

[[To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David, when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.]] Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

[[To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave.]] Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

[[To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave.]] Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
[[To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm or Song.]] God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.
I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
